continuous_domain_audit.criterion_for_positive_k: rho_t*B>rho_w*(M+B), B=Kw/n, M=K+4G/3. Equality is marginal; k=0 has a separate neutral acoustic limit.

continuous_domain_audit.scope: Offline coefficient audit of this manufactured material, not a universal1.2-percent strain restriction, a new production gate or a change to material parameters.

discrete_spectrum_audit.scope: 56 frozen cases: seven modes, J=1 or1.01, k=0 or1e-4, two steps. Actual stored-float h, Eta2 and stress-volume narrowing are retained.
discrete_spectrum_audit.result: All sampled positive-k cases decay under the tested midpoint maps. Every nonzero k0 acoustic mode has strictly positive midpoint amplification, sometimes below the precision of a directly rounded spectral radius. This is not a general stability theorem.

private_necessary_step_guard.policy: Current native n/rho determine cu^2=(M+Kw/n)/rho and D=(Kw/n)*k/gamma. Keep the existing force/CFL structure, take the diffusion minimum, and reject the locked/current/requested step or DtMin outside the bound; do not silently clip FixedDt or uplift DtMin.
private_necessary_step_guard.positive_k_domain: Reject states outside the strict finite-Kw continuous decay domain rho*(Kw/n)>rho_w*(M+Kw/n), including its numerical margin. k0 is treated separately, not certified asymptotically stable.

private_necessary_step_guard.limits: m4 has only four particles per wavelength and is checked against the discrete operator, not admitted as continuum accuracy. A corrector-time rejection leaves an interrupted half-state, not a completed step. RunInitialize can contribute pre-existing FixedDt error history before the new complete-bound calls. No public input, GPU, wall or physical-case acceptance.

limitations: Lstar is not generally quadratic-exact or a conservative pair flux. Necessary private step rejection is not universal spectral/adaptive stability. No general boundary, plasticity, full-cycle, exact restart, GPU or server-package acceptance follows from these private small-amplitude CPU tests.
